# caseclosed

> caseclosed (caseclosedme.com) is a UAE-based online store for anime figures,
> Funko Pops, Pop Mart blind boxes, trading cards, Hot Wheels, and acrylic
> protectors for collectibles. Prices are in AED and include VAT. Flat-rate
> delivery of AED 20 across the UAE. Payments and checkout run on Shopify.

## What we sell

- Funko Pops (anime, Marvel, DC, WWE, movies, exclusives): https://caseclosedme.com/search/funko
- Anime figures (One Piece, Naruto, Dragon Ball, Demon Slayer, Bleach, and more): https://caseclosedme.com/search/figures
- Pop Mart & blind boxes (Labubu and more): https://caseclosedme.com/search/blind-box
- Trading cards (Pokemon TCG, One Piece Card Game, Dragon Ball, Riftbound): https://caseclosedme.com/search/trading-cards
- Hot Wheels (mainline, premium, F1, Fast & Furious): https://caseclosedme.com/search/hot-wheels
- Acrylic & soft protectors (Funko, Hot Wheels, TCG): https://caseclosedme.com/search/protectors
- Best sellers: https://caseclosedme.com/search/best-sellers
- New arrivals: https://caseclosedme.com/search/new-arrivals
- Under AED 100: https://caseclosedme.com/search/under-100

## Facts

- Region served: United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and all Emirates); international shipping available
- Currency: AED (all prices VAT-inclusive)
- Delivery: flat AED 20 across the UAE; express AED 35 before the 11:00 AM cut-off; Cash on Delivery AED 30 total (AED 20 delivery + AED 10 handling)
- Payments: Visa and Mastercard debit/credit cards in AED, plus Cash on Delivery across the UAE
